title: In a quasi-compact Hausdorff space the connected component of a point is the intersection of the clopen neighbourhoods
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a quasi-compact Hausdorff space the connected component of a point is the intersection of all clopen subsets containing it (author lemma at source lines 2077-2083, label lemma-connected-component-intersection-compact-Hausdorff). The proof (source lines 2085-2109) reduces to connectedness of that intersection, assumes a separation, separates the two closed pieces by disjoint opens and uses the finite intersection criterion to find a clopen neighbourhood contained in their union, which splits it (proof lines 2085-2108). The separation and the clopen splitting are the substance. H3.
